<!-- Style updates mostly to make sure the caption boxes are all matching -->
<style>
.value-box .caption {
  font-size: 24px;
  color: white
}
.value-box .value {
    color: white;

</style>

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}
# >>> LOAD LIBRARIES <<< #
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(htmltools)

# >>> SET PARAMETERS <<< #
sample_df <- fread(params$sample_df, header = TRUE)
sample <- sample_df$sample[[1]]
min_allele_freq <- params$min_allele_freq
segmented <- params$segmented

# >>> DEFINE FUNCTIONS <<< #
# Function: Section Headers
catHeader <- function(text = "", level = 3) {
  cat(
    paste0(
      "\n\n",
      paste(rep("#", level), collapse = ""),
      " ",
      text,
      "\n\n"
    )
  )
}

# Function: Create formatted table
create_sample_summary_table <- function(sample_df, compact = TRUE) {
  # Select needed columns
  df <- sample_df %>%
    select(any_of(c(
      'sample', 'reference', 'qc_pass', 'lineage', 'mean_sequencing_depth', 'median_sequencing_depth',
      'num_aligned_reads', 'total_variants', 'num_consensus_n', 'num_snps', 'num_iupacs', 'num_deletions',
      'num_deletion_sites', 'num_insertions', 'num_insertion_sites',
      'genome_completeness', 'minor_snps', 'minor_indels', 'nextclade_frameshifts', 'nonsense_mutations', 'mutated_stop_codons'
    )))

  # Rename columns
  df <- df %>%
    rename(
      "Sample" = sample,
      "QC Pass" = qc_pass,
      "Mean Depth" = mean_sequencing_depth,
      "Median Depth" = median_sequencing_depth,
      "Total Aligned Reads" = num_aligned_reads,
      "Variant Count" = total_variants,
      "# Masked Sites" = num_consensus_n,
      "# SNPs" = num_snps,
      "# Del" = num_deletions,
      "# Del Sites" = num_deletion_sites,
      "# Ins" = num_insertions,
      "# Ins Sites" = num_insertion_sites,
      "Genome Completeness" = genome_completeness
    )

  # Conditional renames based on available columns
  if ("reference" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename("Segment Reference Name" = reference)
  }

  if ("num_iupacs" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename("# IUPACs" = num_iupacs)
  }

  if ("lineage" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename("Lineage" = lineage)
  }

  if ("minor_snps" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename(
      "# Minor SNPs" = minor_snps,
      "# Minor Indels" = minor_indels
    )
  }

  if ("nextclade_frameshifts" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename(
      "Frameshifts" = nextclade_frameshifts,
      "Nonsense Mutations" = nonsense_mutations,
      "Mutated Stop Codons" = mutated_stop_codons
    )
  }

  # Remove name columns depending on if the table is displayed in summary tab or segment tab
  if (isTRUE(compact)) {
    df <- df %>% select(-any_of(c("Sample", "Segment Reference Name")))
  } else {
    df <- df %>% select(-any_of("Sample"))
  }

  # Build table options
  table_options <- list(
    scrollX = FALSE,
    scrollY = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all"))
  )
  if (isTRUE(compact)) {
    table_options$dom <- 't'
    table_options$paging <- FALSE
  }

  # Create table
  df %>%
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = table_options
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      'Genome Completeness',
      background = styleColorBar(range(0,1), 'lightblue', angle = -90),
      backgroundSize = '88% 88%',
      backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat',
      backgroundPosition = 'left'
    )
}

# Function: Horizontal Line for plotly
hline <- function(y = 0, color = "black") {
  list(
    type = "line",
    x0 = 0,
    x1 = 1,
    xref = "paper",
    y0 = y,
    y1 = y,
    line = list(color = color, dash = "dash")
  )
}

# Function: Genome completeness colour palette
get_genome_completeness_color <- function(value) {
  # Create the Red to Yellow to Green color palette for 100 values
  red_to_green_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#FF0039", "#FF7518", "#3FB618"))(100)

  # Calculate the index of the color in the palette based on the input value
  if (value == 0) {
    value <- value + 0.00001
  }
  color_index <- ceiling(value * 100)

  # Return the corresponding color with alpha 0.7
  selected_color <- red_to_green_palette[color_index]
  selected_color <- adjustcolor(selected_color, alpha = 0.7)
  return(selected_color)
}

# Function: Set color and icon based on QC status (used for summary tab when segmented).
get_qc_status_style <- function(status) {
  if (identical(status, "PASS")) {
    list(icon = "", color = "success")
  } else if (identical(status, "INCOMPLETE_GENOME")) {
    list(icon = "", color = "danger")
  } else if (identical(status, "PARTIAL_GENOME")) {
    list(icon = "", color = "orange")
  } else {
    list(icon = "", color = "warning")
  }
}

# Function: Rank QC statuses by severity. Any status not explicitly listed
#  is treated as a warning (used for summary tab when segmented).
qc_status_severity <- function(status) {
  known <- c(
    "PASS" = 0,
    "PARTIAL_GENOME" = 2,
    "INCOMPLETE_GENOME" = 3
  )
  if (status %in% names(known)) known[[status]] else 1
}

# Function: Return the single most severe QC status found across
#  all segments (used for summary tab when segmented).
get_most_severe_qc_status <- function(qc_statuses) {
  individual_statuses <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(qc_statuses, ";", fixed = TRUE)))
  individual_statuses <- individual_statuses[nzchar(individual_statuses)]

  individual_statuses[[
    which.max(vapply(individual_statuses, qc_status_severity, numeric(1)))
  ]]
}

# Function: Render Sample Page
render_sample_page <- function(segment_df) {
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    "childSampleSubpage.Rmd",
    envir = list2env(list(
      sample_df = segment_df,
      sample = segment_df$sample[[1]],
      min_allele_freq = min_allele_freq,
      create_sample_summary_table = create_sample_summary_table,
      catHeader = catHeader,
      segmented = segmented,
      hline = hline,
      get_genome_completeness_color = get_genome_completeness_color
    )),
    quiet = TRUE
  ), sep = "\n")
}

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, eval=isTRUE(segmented) && "reference" %in% names(sample_df)}
# Render the summary tab of the sample page when the virus is segmented
catHeader("Summary", level = 1)
catHeader("Row", level = 2)

# Sample name box
catHeader("Sample Name", level = 3)
valueBox(sample, icon = "")

# Number of segments box
catHeader("Number of Segments", level = 3)
num_segments <- length(unique(as.character(sample_df$reference)))
valueBox(num_segments, icon = "")

# Most severe QC status box
catHeader("Most Severe QC Status", level = 3)
worst_status <- get_most_severe_qc_status(unique(as.character(sample_df$qc_pass)))
status_style <- get_qc_status_style(worst_status)
valueBox(worst_status, icon = status_style$icon, color = status_style$color)

# Sample summary table
catHeader("Row", level = 2)
catHeader("Sample Summary by Segment", level = 3)
create_sample_summary_table(sample_df, compact = FALSE)
```

```{r, sample_pages, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(segmented) && "reference" %in% names(sample_df)) {
  # Create tabs for each segment
  for (segment_reference in unique(as.character(sample_df$reference))) {
    segment_df <- sample_df[as.character(sample_df$reference) == segment_reference, ]

    page_label <- if (is.na(segment_reference) || segment_reference == "") {
      "Unspecified segment"
    } else {
      segment_reference
    }
    cat("\n\n", page_label, "\n", strrep("=", nchar(page_label)), "\n\n", sep = "")

    render_sample_page(segment_df)
  }
} else {
  render_sample_page(sample_df)
}
```
